sourceText.he: וְנוֹהֵג בַּשְּׁלִיל. אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: וְחֶלְבּוֹ מוּתָּר לְדִבְרֵי הַכֹּל.

positions.claim: the mishna's 'and its fat is permitted' is agreed by all, not part of R' Yehuda's dissent
the sciatic-nerve prohibition does not apply to a fetus
the sciatic-nerve prohibition does apply to a fetus, yet its fat is permitted
